metadata.automatic_retry: at most one idempotent GET retry only after a reused connection reset/EOF, same proxy
metadata.measurement: Opaque TCP payload in both directions, including SOCKS/TLS; excludes TCP/IP headers, DNS and TCP retransmissions.

metadata.selection: First 1000 source data rows, original order, each queried once
